lines: Then one night, the king of Egypt saw a dream that shook him.
"I have seen seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones, and seven green ears of grain, and others dry. O eminent ones, explain to me my vision."
His advisers had no answer. "A mixture of false dreams," they said.
And suddenly, the man who had been freed remembered. After all those years... he remembered Yusuf.
He went to the prison. "Yusuf, O man of truth, explain this to us."
Yusuf did not bargain for his freedom. He simply gave them the answer, and a plan.
For seven years, plant as usual. What you harvest, leave in its ears, except a little that you eat.
Then seven hard years will come, and eat up what you stored.
Then a year will come with rain, and the people will be relieved.
A forgotten prisoner had just saved a nation from famine.
